title: Duals of separable Banach Spaces as Calkin Algebras and Universal Ideal Quotients
summary: For $\mathbb{K}=\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and every separable Banach space $V$, we use an oracle-relative two-sorted finite-extension construction, whose oracle records the local rational structure of $V$, to construct a separable Banach space $X_V$ such that $$ \operatorname{Cal}(X_V)=\mathcal{B}(X_V)/\mathcal{K}(X_V)\simeq \begin{pmatrix} \mathbb{K}&0\\ V^*&\mathbb{K} \end{pmatrix} $$ as Banach algebras.
